# Top Trust Insurance

> Comprehensive insurance and investment solutions tailored for Canadians.

Top Trust Insurance provides expert guidance and competitive rates on life, travel, disability, critical illness insurance, and registered investment accounts (TFSA, RRSP, FHSA, RESP).

## Key Pages
- [Home Page](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/) - Secure Choice / Top Trust Insurance agency overview, key benefits, and partner insurance carriers.
- [Resources & Tools](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/resources) - Financial needs analysis (FNA) calculator and helpful links/resources.
- [Contact Us](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/contact) - Get in touch with advisors, schedule, office address, and contact form.

## Dynamic Service Pages
All insurance and investment options:
- [Super Visa Insurance](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/services/super-visa-insurance) - Essential medical coverage for parents and grandparents visiting Canada.
- [Visitors Insurance](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/services/visitors-insurance) - Coverage for tourists, workers, and new immigrants to Canada.
- [Life Insurance](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/services/life-insurance) - Term and permanent life plans to protect your family's financial future.
- [Disability Insurance](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/services/disability-insurance) - Income replacement coverage in case of illness or injury.
- [Critical Illness Insurance](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/services/critical-illness-insurance) - Lump-sum benefits to support recovery from severe illnesses.
- [FHSA (First Home Savings Account)](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/services/fhsa) - Tax-free savings solutions for first-time home buyers in Canada.
- [RESP (Registered Education Savings Plan)](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/services/resp) - Education savings plans with government grants for children.
- [RRSP (Registered Retirement Savings Plan)](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/services/rrsp) - Tax-deductible retirement savings and long-term planning tools.
- [TFSA (Tax-Free Savings Account)](https://toptrustinsurance.ca/services/tfsa) - Tax-free growth and flexible withdrawal savings options.
